one_line: US curbs Chinese AI, Google faces oversight and publisher cuts, new speech model launches, India eyes debt financing.

themes.title: US expands AI investment curbs
themes.text: The Treasury announced a proposal to broaden outbound investment restrictions on Chinese companies in AI, biotechnology and other advanced technologies, and to extend the program to Cuba, Iran, North Korea and Russia.

stories.headline: US Treasury proposes expanding investment curbs on Chinese AI and biotech firms

themes.title: Google AI oversight and publisher impact
themes.text: Two DeepMind researchers resigned over concerns about governance of the Pentagon AI contract, and Google’s AI Overviews shifted search results to AI‑generated summaries, paying small fees to publishers.

stories.headline: Two Google DeepMind researchers resign over Pentagon AI contract, oversight concerns
Google’s AI search overhaul reduces traffic and pays tiny fees to publishers

themes.title: New speech model and controversial claim
themes.text: Block unveiled Dessa, a full‑duplex speech‑to‑speech model that runs locally on consumer GPUs, while an OpenAI researcher was mocked after suggesting air‑gapped AIs could communicate via CPU temperature changes.

stories.headline: Block releases Dessa, a full‑duplex speech‑to‑speech model that runs locally
OpenAI researcher mocked for claim air‑gapped AIs could communicate via CPU temperature

themes.title: India seeks debt for AI data centres
themes.text: A Union Bank of India report says India’s AI sector will increasingly rely on debt financing to build data centres, citing rapid GPU obsolescence, limited domestic hardware manufacturing and evolving AI regulations as key risks.

stories.headline: India's AI sector looks to debt financing for data centres amid GPU and regulatory risks
